title: Come Be My Friend, Don't Be So Scared (Hard Version)
statement: The task is to add the fewest segment detectors to m existing ones (n, m up to 2·10^5) so n positions get distinct covering sets, and print them. XOR hashing gives signatures; viewing segment [l,r] as edge (l-1, r) between gaps, two positions collide iff the gaps between them form a union of components. Minimal colliding windows (two pointers) are paired antipodally, i with i+k/2: ceil(k/2) segments, or one more.
